items.excerpt: Meta is rolling out a mandatory v26 update that disables the camera on its Ray-Ban and Oakley smart glasses if the privacy LED is physically tampered with or destroyed, hardening the AI camera-glasses against privacy circumvention.

OpenAI's first hardware product will reportedly be a portable, screenless smart speaker designed as a 'humanlike AI companion' for the home, with a camera, sensors, moving mechanical elements and ChatGPT at its core.

Ahead of the July 22 Unpacked, Samsung is expected to debut the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8 and new smartwatches with expanded Galaxy AI features spanning predictive, agentic and generative photo-editing tools.

Gemini for Home is upgrading the Nest Hub and Smart Display experience with redesigned visual cards for weather forecasts and knowledge answers, using new Material 3 layouts as the AI assistant takes over Google's smart home.

iRobot launched five new self-emptying Roomba robot vacuums under new owner Picea Robotics, led by the Roomba Max 775 with AI-driven navigation, a self-covering roller mop and a dock that washes mops with 165-degree water.
iOS 27 beta 4 continues Apple's rollout of the revamped Siri AI, bringing richer on-device conversations, personal context, on-screen awareness and deeper in-app actions to iPhones this summer.

BrainCo demonstrated a brain-controlled robot AI platform at Shanghai's 2026 World AI Conference: an EEG headset reads brain signals and decodes them into robot commands within 200 milliseconds, hands-free.
